findings.title: conversation_trajectories: 2 of 5 speakers are invisible in the plot (zero-length duplicated-point strokes) while still getting legend entries; markdown wrongly calls the duplicated row 'a drawable line'
findings.repro:
cd /tmp && MPLBACKEND=Agg python - <<'EOF'
import random, re
from convokit import Corpus, download
corpus = Corpus(filename=download('reddit-corpus-small'))
SW=3
usable=lambda c:[u for u in c.get_chronological_utterance_list() if u.text and u.text.strip() and u.text.strip() not in ('[deleted]','[removed]')]
split=lambda t:[s for s in (x.strip() for x in re.split(r'(?<=[.!?])\s+', t)) if s]
cw=lambda t:(max(1,len(split(t))-SW+1) if len(split(t))>=SW else 1)
def substantial(c):
    u=usable(c)
    if not 10<=len(u)<=40 or len(set(x.speaker.id for x in u))<2: return False
    return sum(1 for x in u if cw(x.text.strip())>=2)/len(u)>=0.6
cand=[c for c in corpus.iter_conversations() if substantial(c)]
random.seed(25); conv=random.choice(cand)
per={}
for u in usable(conv): per.setdefault(u.speaker.id,[]).append(cw(u.text.strip()))
for s,w in per.items(): print(s,w,'ALL-INVISIBLE' if all(x==1 for x in w) else '')
EOF
findings.expected: Every legend entry corresponds to at least one visible stroke, or the text explains that single-window utterances are invisible/point-like.
findings.actual:
speaker 'implode573': windows=[1] -> ALL-INVISIBLE=True
speaker 'mattgrum': windows=[1] -> ALL-INVISIBLE=True
(visual: conv_cell11_out0.png shows no yellow-green or blue strokes despite legend entries)

findings.title: stock_forecasting cell 12: the promised 'Kalman forecasts (dashed)' are invisible at the plotted scale
findings.repro:
MPLBACKEND=Agg python - <<'EOF'
import warnings; warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, yfinance as yf, hypertools as hyp
tickers=['AAPL','MSFT','NVDA','JPM']; HOLD=30
raw=yf.download(tickers, period='2y', interval='1d', progress=False, auto_adjust=True)
closes, volumes = raw['Close'], raw['Volume']
train=[]
for tk in tickers:
    lc=np.log(closes[tk].dropna()); lv=np.log(volumes[tk].reindex(lc.index).replace(0,np.nan)).ffill()
    train.append(pd.DataFrame({'log_close':lc.values,'log_volume':lv.values}).iloc[:-HOLD].reset_index(drop=True))
fig=hyp.plot(train, predict='Kalman', t=HOLD, legend=tickers, ndims=2, linewidth=2)
ax=fig.axes[0]
for l in ax.lines:
    if l.get_linestyle()=='--':
        x,y=np.asarray(l.get_xdata()),np.asarray(l.get_ydata())
        print('tail span', round(x.max()-x.min(),3), round(y.max()-y.min(),3), 'axes', ax.get_xlim(), ax.get_ylim())
EOF
findings.expected: Dashed forecast tails visibly distinguishable in the figure the tutorial titles 'Kalman forecasts (dashed)'.
findings.actual: tail spans: xspan 0.001-0.003, yspan 0.002-0.062 within xlim/ylim (-1.1, 1.1) -- invisible at default scale (full view stock_cell12_fresh.png shows no discernible dashes; stock_cell12_tail_zoom.png proves the tails exist)

findings.title: Streaming: stream_max is not honored when smaller than stream_init (consumes and reports stream_init samples)
findings.repro:
MPLBACKEND=Agg python - <<'EOF'
import numpy as np, hypertools as hyp
def inf(dim=10, seed=1):
    rng=np.random.default_rng(seed)
    while True: yield rng.standard_normal(dim)
f=hyp.plot(inf(), stream_init=500, stream_chunk=100, stream_max=300, show=False)
print(f.stream_info['n_samples'])  # 500, not <=300
EOF
findings.expected: At most 300 samples consumed/reported (or a ValueError explaining stream_max < stream_init).

findings.title: Streaming: one sample beyond stream_max is silently consumed from the underlying stream by the truncation peek
findings.repro:
MPLBACKEND=Agg python - <<'EOF'
import numpy as np, hypertools as hyp
pulls=[0]
def gen():
    rng=np.random.default_rng(0)
    while True:
        pulls[0]+=1
        yield rng.standard_normal(10)
hyp.plot(gen(), stream_init=200, stream_chunk=100, stream_max=1200, show=False)
print('pulled:', pulls[0])  # 1201
EOF
findings.expected: Exactly stream_max samples consumed, or the +1 peek documented in the stream_max docstring.

findings.title: impute silently fills never-observed (all-NaN) columns with 0.0 without any warning
findings.repro:
python - <<'EOF'
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, hypertools as hyp
df = pd.DataFrame(np.random.default_rng(0).standard_normal((50, 3)), columns=list('abc'))
df['c'] = np.nan
out = hyp.impute(df, model='Kalman')
print(out['c'].abs().max())  # 0.0, no warning emitted
EOF
findings.expected: UserWarning: column 'c' has no observed values; imputed values are uninformed (filled with 0.0).
findings.actual: Column returned as all 0.0 with no warning (both model='Kalman' and model='PPCA').
